deep_analysis:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
TRADE WATCHDOG — WARNING (23:20 UTC cycle)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

Open Trades: 3 (3 long, 0 short) — all in profit, none protected by a real ratchet except BTC
Unrealized PnL: +0.21 USDT (HYPER +0.60% @0.064897, HYPE +0.44% @76.29, BTC +0.31% @80545)
Regime: 5m aggregate LONG_BIAS (58L/4S/67N of 129 @23:00) | btc_15m LONG_BIAS | btc_4h SHORT_BIAS | regimes.BTC NEUTRAL | continuum ABOVE EMA300 80451 (+131) | Vol/volume LOW | auto-trader CHOP
Flip rate: aggregate 17/24h, BTC 17/24h — inside band (p50=19, p95=26), standing churn, not an anomaly. <6 (real trend tape) has not occurred since Oct 2.

── Steers ──────────────────────────────────────
🔴 [profit_lock] HYPE #16383 — move SL 75.7301 → 75.958 (entry) manually. Verified no automated path exists: hl_copy_trader is in PROFIT_MONSTER_BYPASS_SIGNALS (profit_monster sees "Found 1 open positions" — BTC only), and the ATR engine has not written since 20:17 because it is pinned at the ATR_SL_MIN_ACCEL floor entry×0.997 = 75.730, i.e. a hard −0.30% cap. Condition re-tested 23:15: price 76.41 ≥ 75.95, holds. age=4 cycles unexecuted.
🔴 [regime] Hold all 3 LONGs only while BTC 1m holds above EMA300; exit = 3 consecutive 1m closes below. Re-tested 23:15: gap +131, consecutive_below=0 — but the gap narrowed 171→131 in 30 min (EMA rising while price flat). If convergence continues, the governing condition reaches 0 in ~60 min, so re-test before acting on any direction-flavored reading. age=4 cycles unexecuted.
🟡 [cluster] 100% one-way book (3 long, 0 short) with asymmetric protection: BTC has a live PM trail (armed 23:09, peak 0.4029, floor +0.20%), HYPE and HYPER have NO profit lock — an EMA300 break exits BTC at ~breakeven+ and the two alts at their −0.30% ATR caps (HYPER still climbing toward it: SL 0.06346→0.06419 since 22:38, floor 0.064316). age=4.
🟡 [stale/health] HYPER #16387 — RETRACTED: "exit by 23:47 if no 1m close ≥0.064767". Condition reversed at 23:05 — 11 consecutive 1m closes ≥ arm (last 0.06500, +0.76%). Superseding steer: HYPER cannot lock profit either (pump-chain+ is PM-bypassed, pump-exit trail floored at −0.30%), so once its ATR trail reaches 0.064316, move SL to entry manually or accept the −0.30% cap as the worst case.
🟢 [info] BTC #16385 — PM trail ARMED at 23:09 (profit_monster log [TRAIL] BTC activated: pnl=0.40% peak=0.40% trail_floor=0.20%). First real ratchet of the book; stop floor is now +0.20%, not −0.80%.
🟢 [opportunity] Hot tape we are not in: NIL +5.2%, USELESS +2.19%, GRASS +2.35%, YGG +1.28%, NEAR +0.92% (16×5m candles, regime conf 82-95). 3 of 6 slots used — but AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False, so no automated capture is possible; manual only.
🟢 [pick] No new AI-trader pick this cycle — ai_trader_state.json written 22:48 (31 min ago, inside the 45-min cooldown). Prior pick stands: ZORA LONG conf 68, watchlist only.

── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────
The book is on the right side of the tape and the tape is decelerating. Aggregate regime flipped LONG_BIAS at 23:00 (58 long / 4 short — the most one-sided reading of the night) and all three positions are long, so direction is aligned with the 5m and 1m sources; the 4h (SHORT_BIAS) and auto_trader (CHOP, MANAGE_ONLY) disagree, which is why every steer is keyed to a re-testable condition rather than to a bias. The single condition holding all three together — BTC above its 1m EMA300 — is weakening: +171 at 22:44, +131 at 23:15, price flat while the EMA climbs. Nothing has broken (0 consecutive closes below), but at this convergence rate the first test arrives within the hour, and on a LOW-volume, NEGATIVE-acceleration tape that test is more likely to be a real break than a dip-buy.

The bigger finding is structural, not directional: two of three open trades have no mechanism that can ever lock profit. profit_monster is the only ratcheting trail and it deliberately skips hl_copy_trader (HYPE) and pump-chain+ (HYPER) — its own log shows "Found 1 open positions". The ATR/pump-exit engine that owns their stops is floored at entry×0.997 by ATR_SL_MIN_ACCEL, so HYPE's stop has been welded at −0.30% since 20:17 and HYPER's is climbing toward the same ceiling. Both trades are +0.44%/+0.60% with a worst case of only −0.30% price — good asymmetry — but neither can turn a winner into a locked winner without a manual move. BTC is the exception: its PM trail armed at 23:09 and floors at +0.20%.

Entry quality, checked against verified 7d bands (meta_rsi only): BTC @5.48 and HYPE @26.79 sit in the winning LONG <35 bucket (4T/3W/+0.17); HYPER @55.56 sits dead centre of the 45-60 bucket that is the largest losing bucket in the book (44T/17W 38.6%/-1.36) and rides pump-chain+, the worst family of the week (14T/2W/-0.88). HYPER is the one position I would not open fresh — it is working (+0.60%) and its downside is capped, but its edge is the ATR trail, not the signal.

Last 24h: 9 closed / 6W / +0.73. Three losers, three failure modes, each with a named winning side: HBAR −0.49% trail_arm_timeout (MFE +0.10% never reached the +0.40% arm — winning side = a coin with room to trend, bb-bounce-v2-long+ is 18T/8W/-0.59 over 7d); CHIP −1.63% shorted at meta_rsi 63.01 and trailed out while the coin kept climbing — CHIP now reads LONG_BIAS conf 91, +0.91% over 16 candles (winning side = long, and we were short); BTC #16377 −3.42% SHORT 23:14→00:00 while BTC held above EMA300 for the whole window (winning side = LONG — the same level that now governs all three open trades). No repeat-failure streak.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────
1. Ratchet HYPE → 75.958 now — nothing automated will do it, and it has been standing 4 cycles.
2. Keep the single EMA300 exit trigger (3 consecutive 1m closes below) wired across all three; re-test this cycle: gap +131 and closing, do not assume it holds.
3. HYPER: deadline steer RETRACTED (arm reached 23:05). Treat its ATR floor 0.064316 as the worst case; manual breakeven if you want the +0.60% locked.
4. Do not add a 4th long until the gap either re-widens above ~+150 or the first break resolves — the book already has one-way exposure with two unprotected legs.
5. New entries at extremes only: LONG meta_rsi <35 (4T/3W/+0.17) or SHORT 60+ (8T/5W/+0.44); never mid-band 45-60 longs (44T/38.6%/-1.36) — HYPER is the exception being carried by its trail, not its edge.

pattern_alerts:
All figures re-verified from PostgreSQL this cycle (RSI = _signal_metadata.rsi_14, never entry_rsi_14).

⛔ CORRECTION TO PATTERN 1 (prior cycles) — the armed/unarmed split as previously stated is a category error.
`trades.trailing_activated` is NOT a live arm flag: DB trigger `trg_trades_trailing_activated` fires only at close, when status='closed' AND exit_reason ILIKE '%trail%'. It is an outcome label written after the fact. Therefore (a) "0 of 3 open trades armed" was meaningless — open trades can never show TRUE — and (b) the 14d split (TRUE 135T/106W 78.5%/+9.93 vs FALSE 192T/16W 8.3%/−13.07, re-run this cycle) is selection-on-outcome: trails close winners by construction, hard SL/manual closes make up the rest. That comparison cannot justify a steer and is retracted.
LIVE protection status, from the actual mechanisms (profit_monster_trail_state.json + position_manager PERSIST log, 23:15):
- BTC #16385: PM trail ACTIVE — [TRAIL] BTC activated 23:09, peak_pnl 0.4029, floor +0.20%. Protected.
- HYPE #16383: no ratchet possible. hl_copy_trader is in PROFIT_MONSTER_BYPASS_SIGNALS (profit_monster log: "Found 1 open positions" = BTC only); ATR engine last wrote 20:17, pinned at ATR_SL_MIN_ACCEL floor entry×0.997 = 75.730 (−0.30% cap). Worst case −0.30% price; no profit lock.
- HYPER #16387: pump-chain+ also PM-bypassed; pump-exit ATR trail IS moving (SL 0.06346 → 0.064189 across 22:38-23:15) but is floored at entry×0.997 = 0.064316 (−0.30% cap). Worst case −0.30% price; no profit lock.
WINNING SIDE: a stop that ratchets into profit (manual move to entry for the two bypassed trades; the PM trail already does this for BTC). WHY WE AREN'T ON IT: 2 of 3 open positions are structurally excluded from the only trail that locks profit.

PATTERN 1 (valid replacement — MFE giveback, flag-independent): the loss mechanism that matters is "reached +0.40% then gave back", which must be measured with candle-walked MFE, not with trailing_activated. The live version this cycle: HYPE crossed +0.40% on 40 consecutive 1m closes and HYPER on 11, neither has any lock above −0.30%. Prior brain/analysis giveback cohorts put this cohort at roughly −$3 over 30d — treat the mechanism as real, the old flag-based split as invalid.

LONG <35 4T/3W/+0.17 | 35-45 6T/2W/−0.26 | 45-60 44T/17W (38.6%)/−1.36 | 60+ 18T/9W/+0.39.
SHORT <35 1T/1W/+0.04 | 35-45 13T/7W/+0.19 | 45-60 10T/2W/−0.26 | 60+ 8T/5W (62.5%)/+0.44.
WINNING SIDE: momentum extremes — LONG <35 or 60+, SHORT 60+. WHY WE AREN'T ON IT: BTC (5.48) and HYPE (26.79) are correctly in <35; HYPER #16387 opened LONG at 55.56, dead centre of the 44T/−1.36 bucket. It is currently +0.60% but carried by its ATR trail, not by entry quality.
